title: [Post-P5] Build work-reference to admitted Contract ingress
body:
## Outcome

Provide the missing front half of the Broodling product path: accept an explicit authoritative work request and produce the entitled source snapshot(s), proposed immutable Contract, and deterministic admission result needed by the existing Attempt/execution path.

**Roadmap:** #74. **Start condition:** after #66 records the P5 evidence/readiness result and any prerequisite blockers relevant to this scope.

## Intended boundary

The initial adapter may use a GitHub issue because that is Broodling's current work-reference profile, but the Contract-construction boundary should not make “GitHub issue Markdown” the permanent internal ontology.

Keep these responsibilities separate:

- **Source acquisition / entitlement:** deterministic Broodling authority records the exact source bytes, locator/provenance, and whether that source is allowed to govern the Work Unit.
- **Semantic extraction / Contract proposal:** natural-language interpretation may use a model/agent to propose criteria, scope, prerequisites and required/permitted effects from the entitled material.
- **Admission / freeze:** deterministic Broodling policy validates supported structure/capabilities and records the immutable Contract revision before any mutating Attempt starts.

A model may propose meaning; it must not grant authority to new sources, silently widen external-effect authority, or mutate an admitted Contract.

## High-level work

Establish the smallest production path from one explicit work reference to an admitted/rejected Contract using the current domain types and store. Preserve exact authoritative input bytes even when a model produces a structured interpretation.

For the first supported GitHub path, use the issue's existing structured prose where possible rather than inventing a large requirements ontology. The complete entitled issue remains available as frozen authority; structured Contract fields should capture only what Broodling needs to admit and execute the Work Unit safely.

Keep the caller boundary capable of evolving toward other source types or caller-supplied structured Contracts without requiring a redesign of Work Unit/Contract authority.

## Completion

Demonstrate representative current Broodling issues flowing from explicit reference to reproducible source snapshot, Contract proposal and deterministic admission/non-admission.

Retain tests for source-entitlement boundaries, proposal/source attribution, immutable revision identity, unsupported/missing capability refusal, and the rule that model extraction cannot self-entitle or silently add authority.

This issue does **not** choose backlog work, run multiple Work Units, implement Cerebrate, expand external effects, redesign P5 assurance, or require a general document-ingestion platform.
